inputs.description: Original classifier inputs are18 integration/segregation features from whole brain and eight networks. Bind authentic awake/LOR labels and responsiveness times for all19 participants and each source evaluation window. These behavioral labels/times determine targets and training exclusions, not prediction features.

preprocessing.description: Preserve original 450-ROI extraction, Pearson dynamic connectivity in 4-minute windows stepping by one TR, and paired GSR/noGSR processing. metric.description: Balanced accuracy = (sensitivity + specificity)/2, higher is better; ROC AUC remains a separate reported endpoint. Static ISD and state-contrast significance are not classification accuracy.

aggregation.description: Preserve source mean balanced accuracy and SEM across all19 participants, with per-participant confusion counts and AUC/ROC companions. Source reports0.984 AUC, but whether the displayed mean ROC-curve AUC equals subject-macro AUC is unresolved; retain both representations separately until authenticated. No pooled-window mean or chosen participant subset may substitute.
